input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Enable returns
启用售后
input-field.helpText: When disabled, the storefront offers no return form and no existing return can be opened. The administration keeps working, so a return that is already in progress can still be decided.
关闭后门店前台不再显示售后入口，已有的售后单也无法打开；后台不受影响，进行中的售后仍可处理。

input-field.name: allowGuest
input-field.label: Allow guest returns
允许游客申请售后
input-field.helpText: Guests order without an account. When enabled, they can open a return with their order number and the email address of the order - no account needed.
游客下单没有账号。开启后，游客凭订单号和下单邮箱即可提交售后申请，无需注册。

input-field.name: windowDays
input-field.label: Return window in days
售后申请期限（天）
input-field.helpText: How long after the delivery an order may still be returned. 0 closes the window immediately.
订单送达后多少天内仍可申请售后。填 0 表示不开放售后申请。

input-field.name: windowStartsAtDelivery
input-field.label: Start the window at the delivery
期限从送达时间起算
input-field.helpText: When enabled, the window counts from the delivery. When disabled, it counts from the order date - only useful for a shop whose orders are never shipped.
开启后按送达时间起算；关闭后按下单时间起算，仅适用于不发货的店铺。

input-field.name: approvalDeadlineHours
input-field.label: Decision deadline in hours
处理期限（小时）
input-field.helpText: A return nobody decided on within this many hours is reported as overdue and, if "approve automatically" is on, approved by the scheduled task.
超过该时长仍未处理的售后单会被标记为逾期；若开启「自动同意」，计划任务会自动通过。

input-field.name: autoApprove
input-field.label: Approve a return that ran out of time automatically
逾期自动同意售后
input-field.helpText: A merchant who does not answer must not keep the goods and the money: with this on, the scheduled task approves an overdue return instead of only reporting it. Auto-declining is deliberately not offered.
商家不处理不应既占着货又占着钱：开启后，计划任务会把逾期的售后单自动通过。系统刻意不提供「逾期自动拒绝」。

input-field.name: returnDeadlineDays
input-field.label: Days to ship the parcel back
退回商品期限（天）
input-field.helpText: After an approval of a return-and-refund case, the customer has this many days to hand the parcel to a carrier.
退货退款申请通过后，顾客需在该天数内把商品寄出。

input-field.name: restockOnReceive
input-field.label: Put returned goods back into the stock
收货后自动回补库存
input-field.helpText: When enabled, booking the arrival of a parcel increases the stock of the returned products. Disable it for a shop that inspects goods before they are sellable again.
开启后，确认收到退回商品时自动增加对应商品的库存。需要在质检后才可再次销售时请关闭。
